content:
nina: dropped a new variant of the latency dashboard: compact p95 rows + mini-heatmap thumbnail per service. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/latency-thumbnails

ash: Love the thumbnails. Quick UX Q: do thumbnails reflect the full time range picker or a local service window? feels confusing if they drift independently.

nina: they're tied to the global time range by default. idea was global context -> click thumbnail to expand into focused heatmap for that service.

liam: implementation note: rendering N thumbnails with SVG gradients at scale may spike paint cost. suggestion: render as canvas or prerender static raster at small sizes and reuse.

joel: copy nudge: beneath the thumbnail show "p95: 210ms" not just the sparkline. PMs often look at the number first. also change tooltip copy from "View traces" to "Open trace timeline" for clarity.

ash: accessibility: thumbnails need alt text like "Latency heatmap for user-auth-service, 24h range" and keyboard focusable expand button. and ensure we don't rely on color ramps alone 12; add hatch overlay for high-density bins.

nina: good point on hatch. also thinking about the sampler control: small dropdown in the row with options: Off, 1%, 5%, 10%, 25%. should the control live inline or in the row actions menu?

liam: prefer row actions menu to avoid reflowing the list. inline is discoverable but will change layout when open. if we do inline, anchor a popover that doesn't change height.

joel: toggle copy: currently "Sampler" -> let's use "Trace sampling" as default label. tooltip: "Reduce traces returned to lower query cost and noise." CTA in popover: "Update view" (not Apply).

ash: keyboard patterns: when a row is focused, pressing Enter should open the popover. within popover arrow keys navigate options and Enter confirms. we should avoid global +/- shortcuts because too many collisions.

nina: can we add a compact mode toggle for the whole list (dense rows vs comfy)? that would help users who run big lists and don't want thumbnails.

liam: perf ask: if compact mode hides thumbnails, can we lazy-load thumbnails as they enter viewport? that'll keep initial render fast.

joel: accessibility extra: ensure contrast of the sampling pill meets 3:1 at small sizes and that the popover has role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" and an accessible label.

nina: i'll push a mock with: 1) dense rows (no thumbnails) 2) dense + thumbnails (rasterized) 3) comfy rows (big thumbnails, captions). include copy strings and aria notes.

design-bot: Reminder: design sync tomorrow <2033340600> 9:00am PT. Agenda: thumbnails, sampling UI, keyboard patterns.

ash: one last ask 12; include a small variation where the p95 number is left-aligned (fast scan) vs right-aligned (visual grouping with sparkline). we'll vote in the sync.
